# Hydroponics

Growing plants without soil. Related: [[Veggie]] and [[Water Recovery|the water problem]].

## Nutrient film technique

A thin stream of `nutrient solution` flows past the roots.

```js
const flowRate = 1.5; // liters per minute
```

See the [[Plant Growth Paper]] for evidence, and a dead link: [[Does Not Exist]].
